answer: The registry splits the trust graph into dunes — clusters with no trust edge between them — and a newcomer needs one sponsor from each of three separate dunes. Each sponsor must show a plume of real co-work with the applicant, a verifiable on-chain collaboration, and no member may sponsor more than two newcomers per epoch. A comet pass re-draws dune boundaries every epoch, so a farmer cannot pre-position puppets. Planting 1,000 fakes takes 3,000 genuine collaborations across disconnected communities; an honest applicant arrives with three co-workers they already have.
